attributes.title: Level 5

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about creating your own functions, with and without parameters, to use in your projects to create code that can be called multiple times.

questions.hint: What does a function do in a computer program?
questions.title: [Select one] What is a function?

answers.text: A piece of information that changes how a program is run
A chunk of code that runs whenever it’s called
An action triggering code to run
A set of code where sequence does not matter

questions.correctResponse: The function stored steps to be run whenever preparing for soccer.

questions.hint: What 2 things need to happen in order for a function’s code to run?
questions.title: [Select all that apply] You must create a function container to ________ a function, and use a call function block to ________ a function.
questions.correctResponse: Functions only run when they are called!

questions.hint: What kind of name should be given to a function?
questions.title: [Select one] If a function’s code creates coin sprites, what is an example of a descriptive name for the function?
questions.correctResponse: Names in computer programs should be clear and specific to what that item does.

questions.hint: How do parameters affect how a function’s code runs?
questions.title: [Select one] How are parameters used in a function?

answers.text: They call a function in the code.
They store a variable to be used anywhere in the code.
They help functions adjust to different circumstances.
They repeat a chunk of code.

questions.correctResponse: Parameters give more information to the function, to change how it runs.

subgroups.title: Functions and Parameters!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about creating your own functions, with and without parameters, to use in your projects to create code that can be called multiple times.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Orange Belt! Before you create your final Orange Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! In this level, you’ll learn more about functions, which are chunks of code that run whenever they are called. You’ll learn how to create your own functions to simplify code and make something happen multiple times in a project. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: Function Junction
badges.description: Create functions, with and without parameters, to make something happen in a project.

badges.title: Make Your Own Way
badges.description: Create a new function to be used in a project.

badges.title: Don't Forget To Call
badges.description: Call a user-created function in a project.

badges.title: Customize Your Own Way
badges.description: Create a new function that takes a parameter to be used in a project.

badges.title: Area Code
badges.description: Call a user-created function that takes a parameter in a project.
